name: symbiote-3x
description: Machine-readable Symbiote.js 3.x rules for reusable package, UI, and provider contracts.

rules.name: triple-file-standard
rules.description: Production components are split into .js, .tpl.js, and .css.js files.

rules.name: no-inline-templates
rules.description: Templates are defined in .tpl.js files instead of inline component bodies.

rules.name: reg-call-required
rules.description: Every custom element component calls .reg('kebab-case-tag').

rules.name: css-token-usage
rules.description: Component CSS uses --sn-* custom properties for themeable values.

rules.name: node-safe-core
rules.description: Root, core, manifest, rules, schemas, and tokens remain importable without DOM globals.

rules.name: single-binding-block
rules.description: Each template element has at most one Symbiote binding block.

rules.name: published-library-contract
rules.description: Public metadata, rules, schemas, and token files are reachable from package exports and files[].

rules.name: agent-boundary
rules.description: Agent-facing manifests describe modules and rules without importing browser components.

rules.name: public-subpath-imports
rules.description: Consumers import symbiote-ui through package exports instead of relative package internals or deep implementation paths.

rules.name: light-dom-host-selector
rules.description: Light DOM rootStyles use the registered custom element selector as the host selector; Shadow DOM styles use :host. Shared CSS that must run in both modes includes both selectors.

rules.name: theme-cascade-contract
rules.description: Themeable components consume inherited CSS custom properties and do not require per-component applyTheme calls or local token resets.

rules.name: css-data-for-visual-tokens
rules.description: Static visual tokens such as colors, spacing, radius, typography, and icon fonts are carried by CSS custom properties; PubSub and JS setters are reserved for application state or explicit dynamic measurements.

rules.name: data-driven-runtime-ui
rules.description: Reusable UI primitives expose clean data, props, events, and manifest metadata so agents can assemble layouts and functionality at runtime without product-specific coupling.

rules.name: theme-rule-block-composition
rules.description: Themes are composed from named rule blocks: source accents, derived color formulas, geometry formulas, typography formulas, motion/effect formulas, semantic aliases, and component aliases.

rules.name: geometry-cascade-formulas
rules.description: Spacing, radius, stroke, density, panel gaps, and component sizing derive from root geometry tokens through documented formulas instead of unrelated fixed values.

rules.name: color-cascade-formulas
rules.description: Surface, text, border, accent, state, and overlay tokens derive from source palettes or accent tokens through documented formulas with contrast-aware roles.

rules.name: interaction-effect-formulas
rules.description: Hover, focus, active, selected, loading, error, and transition effects derive from semantic state tokens and motion formulas, not per-component bespoke effects.

rules.name: no-legacy-ui-shell-classes
rules.description: Reusable and provider-owned UI must not introduce legacy .ui-* shared shell classes; use provider custom elements, host selectors, or component-namespaced classes.

rules.name: data-display-selection-rules
rules.description: Rules directing agents to select list, tree, table, timeline, or description surfaces appropriately based on dataset characteristics.

rules.name: no-hardcoded-visual-values
rules.description: Component CSS must not use raw hex, rgb(), hsl(), or named CSS colors outside accepted functional exceptions (ColorPicker swatches, media poster geometry, known-accent foreground). Use --sn-* cascade tokens.
